title: Close the cap proof's result segment over three strength values
action:
Per D1/D2/D3. Add a named three-value constant — green:live, green:unit, green:static — to packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/finish_support.rs, modelled on ROUTE_CLASS_VALUES (state_group/workflows.rs:287-288), with each value's meaning in a comment beside it: live = the real product or command was driven and its observable result inspected; unit = automated tests passed; static = it compiled, type-checked, linted, or a parity/pointer check passed, with nothing executed.

CHECK IT IN `parse_report_flag`, in the match arm at :195-196 immediately BESIDE the existing `red` arm, on the tuple parse_tests_proof returns. Do NOT touch parse_tests_proof itself, and do NOT touch proof.rs's feature_proof_check. That inaction IS D2: proof.rs:61 calls the same parser, so closing the parser would retroactively refuse ~200 historical capped cells. Add a comment at the parse_tests_proof definition saying the vocabulary is deliberately NOT checked there and naming why, so a later reader does not 'fix' it.

The refusal must name all three values, the way the route-class refusal names its legal set. Update the refusal-message example at finish_support.rs:204 — it currently reads (e.g. "cargo test -p bee — green — touched close.rs") and would otherwise teach the form it now refuses. The message at :211 carries no example and needs no change.

Pin the refusal message with a test, the second half of the model (state_group/tests.rs:1725 pins the route-class one). Add unit tests both ways: a bare `green` refuses naming the three; `green:unit` caps. And add the D2 test: a cell already capped with a bare `green` still passes feature_proof_check with NO read-path code changed.

Write-path test fixtures elsewhere in the crate will go red from this change — that is expected and they are yours to update. Read-path fixtures must KEEP their bare `green`: proof.rs carries two, and each should gain a one-line comment marking it as deliberate D2 evidence so a later sweep cannot silently kill it.
acceptance: A bare green refuses at cells finish with a typed message naming green:live, green:unit and green:static. green:unit caps. parse_tests_proof and feature_proof_check are unedited except for comments. A capped bare-green cell still passes the close door. The refusal message is pinned by a test.
